descriptionChirho: Qal: to move, be displaced from one's position, said of rocks and mountains (Job 14:18, 18:4)
Qal: to advance in years, grow old and weak; an Aramaism (Job 21:7 of the wicked; Ps 6:8 of the eye growing dim)
Hiphil: to move forward, proceed on a journey, relocating camp or tent (Gen 12:8, 26:22)
Hiphil: to remove or displace, said of God removing mountains (Job 9:5); also of words departing from someone (Job 32:15)
Hiphil: to transcribe or copy from one scroll to another, a late usage (Pr 25:1, of Hezekiah's men copying Solomon's proverbs)
